verdict.rationale: Column documents a card program offering both virtual and physical cards via Visa/Mastercard issuing (docs-11, comm-2), tied to its account APIs, but there is no evidence of spend-control features (limits, controls) or digital wallet (Apple/Google Pay) provisioning in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit spend-control API details, digital wallet tokenization/provisioning support, independent confirmation of card issuance in production.
